mapper.select: SELECT n.id AS note_id, n.title AS notebook_title,n.is_marked AS notebook_is_marked ,n.summary AS notebook_summary, n.created_at AS notebook_created_at,n.updated_at AS notebook_updated_at, n.sort_order as notebook_sort_order, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, t.color AS tag_color FROM note AS n LEFT JOIN note_tag AS nt ON n.id = nt.note_id LEFT JOIN tag AS t ON nt.tag_id = t.id WHERE n.notebook_id = #{notebookId} AND n.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY n.sort_order DESC , n.created_at DESC

SELECT n.id AS note_id, n.title AS notebook_title,n.is_marked AS notebook_is_marked ,n.summary AS notebook_summary, n.created_at AS notebook_created_at,n.updated_at AS notebook_updated_at, n.sort_order as notebook_sort_order, t.id AS tag_id, t.name AS tag_name, t.color AS tag_color FROM note AS n LEFT JOIN note_tag AS nt ON n.id = nt.note_id LEFT JOIN tag AS t ON nt.tag_id = t.id WHERE n.user_id = #{userId} AND n.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY n.sort_order DESC, n.created_at DESC
